title: Autonomous Agent Runtime
description: A self-updating autonomous agent environment with memory and a built-in code editor.
fulldescription:
This prototype launches a complete, self-sustaining AI agent environment. It uses **Amazon Bedrock AgentCore** to run an autonomous agent capable of complex reasoning and memory retention. Unlike simple chatbots, this agent runs inside a secure container hosted on **Amazon ECR**. 

The stack includes a web-based **Code Editor** where you can modify your agent's Python logic directly. When you save changes, **AWS CodeBuild** automatically rebuilds the agent's container and redeploys it without any downtime. **Amazon DynamoDB** and **Bedrock Memory** track conversation history and state, while **API Gateway** provides the interface for the chat UI. It's a full 'DevOps-in-a-box' for AI agents.

services.name: Bedrock AgentCore
services.desc: Orchestrates the autonomous agent and manages its memory.

services.name: AWS CodeBuild
services.desc: Automatically rebuilds your agent's container when you edit code.

services.name: Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR)
services.desc: Stores the Docker container images for your agent.

services.name: Lambda
services.desc: Handles the code editor API and deployment triggers.

services.name: S3
services.desc: Hosts the web interface and stores build artifacts.

services.name: Amazon DynamoDB
services.desc: Tracks the state of deployments and updates.

services.name: API Gateway
services.desc: Connects the frontend chat and editor to the backend services.

💡 Cost Saving Tips
• Builds: You are only charged for CodeBuild when you click 'Deploy' in the editor. Viewing the code is free.
• Cleanup: Delete the stack when finished to remove the ECR images and S3 buckets, which are the only persistent costs.
